title: NGS Library Prep Cleanup for 96 Samples
author: Opentrons
materials: Download your protocol and unzip if needed.

steps.title: Prepare library cleanup
steps.instruction: This protocol performs a custom NGS library prep cleanup for up to 96 samples.

steps.title: Enter protocol parameters
steps.instruction: Input your protocol parameters in the provided fields.

steps.title: Download and unzip protocol
steps.instruction: Download the protocol file and unzip it if needed.

steps.title: Upload custom labware
steps.instruction: Upload your custom labware JSON files to the OT App via More > Custom Labware > Add Labware.

steps.title: Upload protocol file
steps.instruction: Upload the protocol .py file to the OT App in the Protocol tab.

steps.title: Set up deck
steps.instruction: Arrange the deck according to the provided deck map.

steps.title: Calibrate labware and pipette
steps.instruction: Calibrate your labware, tip rack, and pipette using the OT App; see support articles for calibration tips.

steps.title: Run the protocol
steps.instruction: Press Run to start the protocol.
